profile.name: Michał
profile.role: Junior Software Engineer | CS Student at CUT | Coding Tutor at Kodland

about.description: I am a 6th-semester Computer Science student at the Cracow University of Technology (PK). My path to IT was a natural choice—I have always excelled in STEM fields, and my passion for mathematics has translated into an analytical approach to problem-solving. I am not afraid of challenges; immediately after high school, I entered the workforce, which allowed me to develop a strong sense of responsibility and excellent time management skills before starting my technical career. Currently, I am seeking my first professional opportunity to gain insight into how technological processes function from within and to bring value to real-world, commercial projects.
